newsitem.title: USA: Monaco Coach says to resume operations after fire.
newsitem.headline: Monaco Coach says to resume operations after fire.

text.p: Monaco Coach Corp said on Thursday it suffered a fire Wednesday afternoon in one of the buildings at its manufacturing facilities in Coburg, Ore.
Monaco said in a press release that it believes it can resume normal operations at the plant by next Monday and the plant itself was not significantly damaged by the fire.
The company's preliminary estimate, places the damages between $1 and $2 million. Three motor coaches in the "final finish" production area were lost and some others experienced smoke damage.
Monaco believes it has adequate insurance coverage for the loss.
The company said two assembly line workers were injured in the accident.

The 300,000 square foot facility handles production of Monaco's high end motor coaches: the Signature Series, Executive, a portion of Dynasty and the Navigator. The plant has been producing at a rate of approximately two units per day.
Monaco is a major maker of luxury motor coaches.
